TRAPS LEARNED: run gh pr merge bare and use --match-head-commit with the full SHA; git push must be alone in its Bash call; zsh does not word-split a variable of flags, so spell quest flags out; the ownership hook refuses any command whose target is built from a shell variable, so use literal paths; gh pr checks is empty for a few seconds after a push, so wait on a minimum row count; quest task complete moves the file to .quest/completed/, so stage the whole .quest/; a task must be In Progress before it can be completed; `declare` is a TypeScript keyword and a const of that name in a test is silently stripped; lore documentation profile max_tokens is 36100, measured about 36066, so ADR 0024 has almost no headroom.
